ONC compliance disclosure page. Confirms certification status, links to FHIR API documentation and Real World Testing plans (2022-2025). No pricing or feature details.

Pricing page with five tiers: Free, Silver ($199/mo), Gold ($349/mo), Platinum ($599/mo), EHR+PM ($565/mo), and Revenue Cycle (custom). All tiers include MU certification, iPad/Android access, patient portal, HIPAA compliance, eRx with EPCS, voice dictation, telemedicine.
Letter from founder Dr. Robert Abbate. Background in web development and medicine. Built OneTouch EMR because existing systems were 'bulky, hard to navigate.' Touch-screen first design for tablets.

iOS app listing. 4.1/5 stars, 24 ratings. Features: physician-designed workflow, touch/type/dictation input, patient portal with check-in, E&M coding helper, electronic lab integration, eRx/EPCS, drawing tools for annotations. Requires iOS 16.0+, 40.7 MB. Also available on Mac M1+ and Apple Vision Pro.

EMRFinder listing. Describes PM, billing, patient records, lab integration, document management, voice dictation, appointment reminders, eRx. Targets Internal Medicine and Family Medicine. Patient portal with telemedicine, online billing, scheduling, medical summary viewing.

EMRSystems listing. Cloud-based EHR with integrated PM, eRx, document management, scheduling, billing, patient portal. Targets Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Pediatrics. Stores patient records, clinical assessments, vital signs, lab results, prescriptions.

FindEMR listing. Details on scheduling views, demographics, telemedicine, e-prescribing with drug interaction checks. Claims integration with '70+ PM systems' (likely overstated). Pricing from $49-$599/mo.

Software Advice profile. Returned 403 on direct fetch but search snippets provided review highlights: users praise ease of use, dictation support, customizable templates. Some concerns about support responsiveness and connectivity issues.

Capterra profile. Returned 403 on direct fetch. Search snippets describe integrated fax, eRx, electronic labs, iPad clinical photos, MIPS/MACRA certified, HIPAA compliant, ICD-10 ready. Users praise customizability and month-to-month contracts.

Interview with Dr. Abbate. Product emphasizes '3Fs': Familiar, Flexible, Fast. Uses HL7 for billing/PM integration. SaaS model. Targets independent practitioners and small practices. Free access offered to medical students.
QA testing firm lists OneTouch EMR as customer. Founded 2010 by Dr. Abbate. iPad app and web-based. Virtual reception, touch/type/Dragon dictation. Dallas headquarters.
